display_long_description:
VoxelCross is a premium 3D nonogram (Picross-style) puzzle experience built for virtual reality.

Enter a carefully crafted voxel world where logic and spatial reasoning come together. Guided by numerical clues, carve away blocks layer by layer to reveal hidden 3D structures.
[media]
Designed specifically for VR, VoxelCross offers intuitive interaction, allowing players to inspect, rotate, and solve puzzles from any perspective.
Designed specifically for VR, VoxelCross offers intuitive interaction, allowing players to inspect, rotate, and solve puzzles from any perspective.

🧩 Key Features
Full 3D Nonogram Gameplay
Solve puzzles in true three-dimensional space.
Precision VR Interaction
Comfortable and accurate controller-based input.
80+ Curated Levels
A smooth progression from beginner-friendly stages to more complex challenges.
Rewarding Visual Results
Each puzzle reveals a unique voxel model.
Clean, Comfortable Visual Style
Designed for extended play in VR.
🌱 Ongoing Development

VoxelCross is an independently developed title with a focus on quality and long-term updates. More levels and features will continue to be added over time.

💬 Feedback Welcome

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, your feedback is always appreciated.
If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, your feedback is always appreciated.

Take your time. Think in 3D. Solve in VR.
